name: TC-E2E-002 — Brief驳回→重新提交流程 [P1]
description: 端到端Brief驳回流程：买手提交→产运驳回→买手重新编辑→重新提交→产运确认

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const hasRejectInfo = text.includes('驳回原因') || text.includes('驳回'); const rejectReasonVisible = !!document.querySelector('[class*=reject], [class*=alert], .ant-alert'); const hasReEdit = !!Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('重新编辑')); const stepHighlight = document.querySelector('.ant-steps-item-process')?.textContent.trim(); const activeTab = document.querySelector('.ant-tabs-tab-active')?.textContent.trim(); return { hasRejectInfo, rejectReasonVisible, hasReEdit, stepHighlight, activeTab, isBriefTab: activeTab?.includes('Brief') }; })()
steps.description: P1断言: REJECTED_BRIEF状态(驳回原因展示+重新编辑按钮+Brief tab激活)

steps.text: ═══ Phase 2: 首版驳回无版本侧栏 ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const sidebar = document.querySelector('[class*=version-sidebar], [class*=version-list], [class*=version-panel]'); const versionTags = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=version], [class*=tag]')).filter(el => el.textContent.match(/v[0-9]/i)); return { versionSidebarExists: !!sidebar, versionTagCount: versionTags.length, noVersionForFirstReject: !sidebar && versionTags.length === 0 }; })()
steps.description: P2断言: 首版驳回前无版本侧栏(无v1/v2标识)

steps.text: ═══ Phase 3: 点击重新编辑fork新版本 ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const reEditBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('重新编辑') && !b.disabled); if (reEditBtn) { reEditBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, msg: '重新编辑按钮不可用' }; })()
steps.description: P3操作: 点击重新编辑(fork新版本)

steps.expression: (() => { const formEditable = !!document.querySelector('textarea:not([readonly]), input:not([readonly])'); const sidebar = document.querySelector('[class*=version-sidebar], [class*=version-list], [class*=version-panel]'); const versionTags = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=version], [class*=tag], [class*=sidebar] *')).filter(el => el.textContent.match(/v[0-9]/i)); const hasV1 = versionTags.some(el => el.textContent.includes('v1')); const hasV2 = versionTags.some(el => el.textContent.includes('v2')); return { formEditable, sidebarExists: !!sidebar, hasV1, hasV2, versionCount: versionTags.length }; })()
steps.description: P3断言: fork后表单可编辑+版本侧栏展示v1/v2

steps.text: ═══ Phase 4: 修改Brief并重新提交 → PENDING_BRIEF ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const textareas = document.querySelectorAll('textarea:not([readonly])'); for (const ta of textareas) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(ta, ta.value + '（已根据驳回意见修改）'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } return { modified: textareas.length }; })()
steps.description: P4操作: 修改Brief内容(根据驳回意见)

steps.expression: (() => { const submitBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.textContent.includes('提交') || b.textContent.includes('重新提交')) && !b.disabled); if (submitBtn) { submitBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, msg: '提交按钮不可用' }; })()
steps.description: P4操作: 点击重新提交

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const activeStep = document.querySelector('.ant-steps-item-process')?.textContent.trim(); const isPendingBrief = activeStep?.includes('产运确认') || text.includes('待确认'); const briefReadonly = !document.querySelector('textarea:not([readonly])'); const rejectInfoGone = !text.includes('驳回原因'); return { isPendingBrief, activeStep, briefReadonly, rejectInfoGone }; })()
steps.description: P4断言: 状态回到PENDING_BRIEF(步骤条高亮产运确认+Brief只读+驳回提示消失)

steps.text: ═══ Phase 5: 产运确认 + 时间线验证 ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const confirmBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('确认') && !b.textContent.includes('驳回') && !b.disabled); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, msg: '确认按钮不可用' }; })()
(() => { const activeStep = document.querySelector('.ant-steps-item-process')?.textContent.trim(); const isInProduction = activeStep?.includes('试拍'); return { isInProduction, activeStep }; })()
steps.description: P5断言: 确认后状态流转到IN_PRODUCTION

steps.expression: (() => { const timelineBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a, [class*=timeline]')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('时间线')); if (timelineBtn) { timelineBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: P5操作: 打开时间线抽屉

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer, [class*=drawer]'); const text = drawer?.textContent || ''; const hasRejectEvent = text.includes('驳回'); const hasResubmitEvent = text.includes('重新提交') || text.includes('提交'); const hasConfirmEvent = text.includes('确认'); return { drawerOpen: !!drawer, hasRejectEvent, hasResubmitEvent, hasConfirmEvent, allEventsRecorded: hasRejectEvent && hasResubmitEvent && hasConfirmEvent }; })()
steps.description: P5断言: 时间线记录驳回+重新提交+确认事件

_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 验证驳回信息展示
2. 验证首版无版本侧栏
3. 点击重新编辑fork新版本
4. 验证版本侧栏v1/v2
5. 修改并重新提交→PENDING_BRIEF
6. 产运确认→IN_PRODUCTION
7. 时间线记录完整
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 驳回提示区展示驳回原因
2. 首版驳回前无版本侧栏
3. fork后表单可编辑，版本侧栏展示v1/v2
4. 重新提交后回到PENDING_BRIEF，驳回提示消失
5. 产运确认后进入IN_PRODUCTION
6. 时间线记录驳回和重新提交事件
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/端到端
